hero.title: Come find us
hero.subtitle: Tucked just off the high street, two minutes from the Grand Arcade. Look for the Victorian barrow — you can't miss it.

highlight.title: One spot. Forty years. Countless hot dogs.
highlight.subtitle: The same corner of Cambridge since 1986 — rain or shine, we're here.

directions.title: Easy to reach, hard to leave
directions.subtitle: Right in the heart of Cambridge — whether you're walking, cycling or driving.

walking.title: On foot
walking.description: We're on Market Passage, just off the high street between Petty Cury and Market Square. Follow the smell.

cycling.title: By bike
cycling.description: Bike racks on Market Square and the Grand Arcade multi-storey. Lock up and walk 30 seconds.

driving.title: By car
driving.description: Grand Arcade car park (CB2 3BJ) is the closest — 2 minute walk to the barrow from the exit.
